FROM tb_pay_calc_var_n cvn , tb_pay_calc_var_value_n cvh WHERE cvn.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} /* 해외법인코드 */ AND cvn.payroll_calc_variable_id = #{payrollCalcVariableId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND cvn.payroll_calc_variable_id = cvh.payroll_calc_variable_id ORDER BY cvh.effective_end_yyyymmdd DESC

WITH detail_list AS ( /* 삭제 건 제외한 리스트 조회 */ SELECT /* LGVPAY10001.retireveValidateGlobalValueHistoryData */ payroll_calc_variable_id /* 급여산출변수아이디 */ , result_value /* 결과문자값 */ , effective_start_yyyymmdd /* 유효시작년월일 */ , effective_end_yyyymmdd /* 유효종료년월일 */ FROM tb_pay_calc_var_value_n WHERE payroll_calc_variable_id = #{parameter.payrollCalcVariableId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 삭제건이 있는 경우 제외 처리 */ AND effective_start_yyyymmdd NOT IN #{deleteItem.oriEffectiveStartYyyymmdd} ) , rs AS ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(#{parameter.payrollCalcVariableId}) AS payroll_calc_variable_id , #{createItem.resultValue} AS result_value , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{createItem.effectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS effective_start_yyyymmdd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{createItem.effectiveEndYyyymmdd} , 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM dual UNION ALL /* 신규건이 있는 경우 기존데이터와 union하기 위해 union 함 */ SELECT NVL(update_list.payroll_calc_variable_id, detail_list.payroll_calc_variable_id) AS payroll_calc_variable_id , NVL(update_list.result_value , detail_list.result_value ) AS result_value , NVL(update_list.effective_start_yyyymmdd, detail_list.effective_start_yyyymmdd) AS effective_start_yyyymmdd , NVL(update_list.effective_end_yyyymmdd , detail_list.effective_end_yyyymmdd ) AS effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM detail_list , ( /* 수정건이 있는 경우 Detail 항목 리스트와 outer join 하여 등록된 최종 Detail 리스트를 조회한다 */ SELECT TO_NUMBER(#{parameter.payrollCalcVariableId}) AS payroll_calc_variable_id , #{updated[${idx}].resultValue} AS result_value , #{updated[${idx}].oriEffectiveStartYyyymmdd} AS ori_effective_start_yyyymmdd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{updated[${idx}].effectiveStartYyyymmdd}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS effective_start_yyyymmdd , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{updated[${idx}].effectiveEndYyyymmdd} , 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYYMMDD') AS effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM dual ) update_list WHERE detail_list.payroll_calc_variable_id = update_list.payroll_calc_variable_id(+) AND detail_list.effective_start_yyyymmdd = update_list.ori_effective_start_yyyymmdd(+) SELECT detail_list.payroll_calc_variable_id , detail_list.result_value , detail_list.effective_start_yyyymmdd , detail_list.effective_end_yyyymmdd FROM detail_list ) SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT listagg(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY'), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) FROM rs GROUP BY rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd HAVING COUNT(1) > 1) AS dup_start_date /* Effective Start Date 중복 */ ,(SELECT DISTINCT listagg(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY'), ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd) OVER (PARTITION BY 1) FROM rs WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM rs rs0 WHERE rs0.payroll_calc_variable_id = rs.payroll_calc_variable_id /* 시작일 또는 종료일이 기간내에 포함된 경우 */ AND (rs0.effective_start_yyyymmdd BETWEEN rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd AND rs.effective_end_yyyymmdd OR rs0.effective_end_yyyymmdd BETWEEN rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd AND rs.effective_end_yyyymmdd) GROUP BY rs0.payroll_calc_variable_id HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) GROUP BY rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd) AS dup_period /* Effective Start Date, Effective End Date 기간 중복 */ ,(SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(rs.payroll_calc_variable_id) > 0 THEN MAX((SELECT lsmm.message_detail_content FROM lgcom_system_message_m lsmm WHERE lsmm.system_message_id = 'error.DataRangePickerFromDate' AND lsmm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode})) END FROM rs WHERE rs.effective_start_yyyymmdd > rs.effective_end_yyyymmdd) AS invalid_period /* 종료일이 시작일 이전인 경우 */ ,(SELECT '
'||lslm.label_name||'=' FROM lgcom_screen_label_m lslm WHERE lslm.label_id = 'EffectiveStartDate' AND lslm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}) AS dup_start_date_title FROM dual
